    (A : (Fin n → ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ))
    (c : (Fin n → ℕ) → RatFunc ℚ)
    (β : Fin n → ℕ) (hβ : ∀ i, β i ≤ d) (hs : ∑ i, β i = d)
    (L : MvPolynomial (Fin n) (RatFunc ℚ) →ₗ[RatFunc ℚ] RatFunc ℚ)
    (hL : ∀ b : Fin n → ℕ, (∑ i, b i) = d →
      L (A b) = if b = β then 1 else 0)
    (hc : x2611_16899_expansion n d P A c) :
    L P = c β := by
  classical
  let γ₀ : Fin n → Fin (d + 1) := fun i => ⟨β i, Nat.lt_succ_of_le (hβ i)⟩
  have hval : (fun i => (γ₀ i).val) = β := rfl
  calc
    L P = ∑ γ : Fin n → Fin (d + 1),
        if (∑ i, (γ i).val) = d then
          c (fun i => (γ i).val) * L (A (fun i => (γ i).val)) else 0 := by
      rw [hc, map_sum]
      apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
      intro γ _
      split_ifs <;> simp [MvPolynomial.C_mul', map_smul]
    _ = c β := by
      rw [Finset.sum_eq_single γ₀]
      · rw [hval, if_pos hs, hL β hs, if_pos rfl, mul_one]
      · intro γ _ hne
        split_ifs with hsum
        · rw [hL _ hsum, if_neg, mul_zero]
          intro he
          apply hne
          funext i
          exact Fin.ext (congrFun he i)
        · rfl
      · simp

              MvPolynomial.C (τ ^ k) * MvPolynomial.X ij.1 ^ k *
                MvPolynomial.X ij.2 ^ (n - k)
        else 1
    let m : Fin n →₀ ℕ := Finsupp.equivFunOnFinite.symm
      (fun i => 1 + (n + 1) * i.val)
    ∀ b : Fin n → ℕ, (∑ i, b i) = n →
      MvPolynomial.coeff m (A b * W) = if b = (fun _ => 1) then 1 else 0 := by
  classical
  dsimp only
  sorry
